environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'ci-artifacts-prod' fronted by AWS Application Load Balancer with gRPC target group (protocol version gRPC). ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule in COUNT mode, (2) a custom rule group 'grpc-payload-inspection' with a ByteMatchStatement targeting the request body for sequences matching '../' and '..\\' with TextTransformation URL_DECODE and BASE64_DECODE applied, action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in BLOCK mode. The pod itself runs with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and allowedHostPaths restricted via PodSecurityPolicy (legacy, still enforced on this cluster version 1.24). An emptyDir volume is mounted at /app/uploads with sizeLimit 50Mi. The container runs as UID 1000 (non-root). However, the WAF custom rule 'grpc-payload-inspection' is the primary gate — it inspects the serialized gRPC body bytes after base64 and URL decoding for path traversal sequences before the request reaches the pod.
